_meta.description: Australia-specific series catalogue for the Australia Macro Heatmap. Single source of truth for Australia series identity, source, and ingestion metadata. 52 series covering Growth, Inflation, Employment, Wages, and Financial Conditions.

field_reference.id: Unique machine-readable slug. Used to cross-reference series across tools and config files.
field_reference.name: Human-readable short label.
field_reference.description: What the series measures and why it matters.
field_reference.source: Data vendor: bloomberg | haver | ecb | eurostat | derived.
field_reference.ticker_bloomberg: Bloomberg ticker string (e.g. 'PMITUKG Index'). null if not available on Bloomberg.
field_reference.ticker_haver: Haver mnemonic (e.g. 'PMIUKCO@EMERGE'). null if not available on Haver.
field_reference.units: Unit/scale of the raw series as pulled from source.
field_reference.typical_lag_days: Calendar days from reference period end to typical publication date. null for daily market data (no publication lag).
field_reference.asset_class: Grouping: macro_survey | macro_activity | macro_inflation | macro_labour | government_bonds | rates_swaps | inflation_swaps | commodities | volatility.
field_reference.geography: Primary geographic scope of the series.
field_reference.tools: List of tool IDs in the hub that consume this series.
field_reference.role: How the series is used: factor_input (DFM macro block) | target (y-variable in regression model) | predictor (x-variable) | market_data (general market series).
field_reference.dfm_factor: For factor_input series: which DFM factor this series primarily identifies (Growth | Inflation | Employment | Wages). Housing series are assigned Growth.
field_reference.dfm_sign: For factor_input series: +1 if series moves in the same direction as the factor, -1 if inverse (e.g. unemployment rate is -1 for Employment factor).
field_reference.dfm_col_index: Zero-based column index in the DFM observation matrix Y_daily. Must be contiguous 0-47.
field_reference.dfm_primary: True for exactly one series per factor group — the sign-anchor series used for PCA orientation.
field_reference.heatmap_group: Display grouping label used in the Australia heatmap UI.
field_reference.notes: Free-text caveats, data quirks, or ingestion instructions.

series.name: GDP (y/y)
series.description: ABS Australia GDP year-on-year % change.
series.notes: ticker_haver could not be confirmed against the real Haver ANZ database in this pass (original value referenced a nonexistent 'AUDATA' database) - needs manual lookup via Haver metadata search before enabling ANALYTICS_DATA_SOURCE=haver for this series.

series.name: Current Account (AUDbn)
series.description: ABS Australia current account balance in AUDbn SA, quarterly.
series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code: BOP Current Account Balance (SA, Mil.A$).

series.name: PMI Manufacturing (Judo Bank)
series.description: Judo Bank/S&P Global Australia Manufacturing PMI. Above 50 = expansion. Primary Growth factor anchor.
series.notes: Primary Growth indicator; use composite if available. Haver EMERGE was unavailable in the live check, so its ticker was cleared from the active mapping.

series.name: PMI Services (Judo Bank)
series.description: Judo Bank/S&P Global Australia Services PMI. Above 50 = expansion.
series.notes: Haver EMERGE was unavailable in the live check, so its ticker was cleared from the active mapping.

series.name: NAB Business Confidence

series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code: NAB Business Survey Business Conditions (SA, %Bal).

series.description: ABS Australia unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted. Primary Employment factor anchor.

series.name: Employment Change (k)
series.description: ABS Australia employment change in thousands SA.
series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code is the employment LEVEL (SA, Thous), not a pre-built change series - apply chg() or diff for the k/m-o-m change.

series.name: Participation Rate (%)

series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code: Labor Force Participation Rate (SA, %).

series.name: Hours Worked (m/m)
series.description: ABS Australia total hours worked, month-on-month % change SA.
series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code is a quarterly SA hours-worked index (FY2024=100), not a monthly m/m series - frequency mismatch, needs review.

series.name: Job Vacancies — ABS (k)
series.description: ABS Australia job vacancies in thousands, seasonally adjusted quarterly.
series.notes: Confirmed real Haver ANZ code: Job Vacancies Australia (SA, Thous).
